method: Opened seven chapter reference targets and inspected relevant passages, plus the official T6 and T18 descriptions for the approved illustrative parking assembly. Other individual sign captions/artwork reuse the verified register with hash/size checks; not a claim that every sign page was fetched again.

sources.finding: Chapter 2 §1 and chapter 3 §§15, 21, 45–55 and 58 support consideration, bus departures at limits up to 50 km/h, reversing, stopping/parking distances, unmarked bus-stop extent, vehicle security, doors and the weekday 24-hour/disc rules. Chapter 8 §§1–1a confirms special-street rules; chapter 10 §1 allows lawful local parking arrangements. Current provisions used; future amendments unrelated to this chapter are not applied.
Riding and leading horses are subject to vehicle provisions where applicable. The manuscript’s cautious passing advice remains a care principle, without inventing a fixed distance.

Walking pace, pedestrian priority and pedestrian-street access exceptions confirmed. Cycle-street maximum 30 km/h, bicycle-traffic adaptation, designated parking and entry/exit yielding duties confirmed.
Definition distinguishes parking from traffic/danger stops, boarding/alighting and goods loading/unloading; driver presence does not settle the classification.

T6 distinguishes ordinary weekday, preceding-day and holiday times, including named days. T7/T8 and T16–T19 supply permit, vehicle, fee, disc, duration and resident qualifications. Reference panels remain independent examples.
Permit benefits are defined and limited; fees and reserved-purpose restrictions still require checking. No unrestricted stopping entitlement is inferred.
Chapter 3 §3 supports critical reflection on driving behaviour; the chapter’s supervised observation exercise follows that purpose.
Time qualifications can qualify other conditions. Black unbracketed 9–18 fits the ordinary-Tuesday assumption.

Maximum duration can be qualified by T6 times. The illustrative 2 tim / 9–18 plate is consistent with the approved example; arrival 10:00 reaches two hours at 12:00. No disc rounding or fee is introduced.

G5_sources.title: Traffic Regulation (1998:1276)
G5_sources.version: Consolidated live text; chapter 3 §§43–45 checked as applicable 13 October 2026
G5_sources.locator: Chapter 3 §45: maximum permitted road speed ≤50, approaching-driver duty and bus caution; §43: safe edge/lateral movement and facilitating observed lane entry
G5_sources.excerpt: utan fara eller onödigt hinder; anpassa hastigheten så att inkörningen underlättas; 50 kilometer i timmen eller lägre
G5_sources.supports: Special bus-stop departure duty at road limits ≤50; no such special duty at 70, but safe-entry and speed-adaptation/cooperation duties remain.
G5_sources.fallback_reason: Inspected TS/TRV results did not establish the complete current 50/70 comparison and reciprocal duties. The current statutory provisions give exact primary legal support.
G5_sources.scope_limits: Ordinary departure from roadside bus stop into the approaching driver’s lane, subject to other applicable controls/rules. Road maximum limit, not actual vehicle speed, determines §45. No unconditional priority or permission to force a gap. “Must give way” in the keyed answer is explained as waiting for a safe entry under §43, not an invented separate always-yield statute.
G5_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page retrieved and exact passage inspected

G5_sources.title: Fakta om ledarhundar
G5_sources.locator: När du möter ett ledarhundsekipage, first and third bullets; Så här arbetar ledarhundar
G5_sources.excerpt: Stör inte ledarhundar som arbetar genom att klappa eller prata med dem.
G5_sources.supports: Avoid petting/talking to distract working guide dogs; distraction can endanger handler; communicate with handler, who chooses route and remains in control.
G5_sources.fallback_reason: No exact guide-dog distraction advice located in TS/TRV searches. MFD is the Swedish government authority responsible for guide-dog services and supplies directly applicable guidance.
G5_sources.scope_limits: Safety/interaction advice, not a newly asserted traffic offence. No claim that the dog alone decides a road is safe or every glance necessarily distracts it.
G5_sources.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page retrieved and exact passage inspected

G5_sources.title: Cykel
G5_sources.locator: Definitionen av en cykel, definition item 1 under Act (2001:559)
G5_sources.excerpt: Ett fordon som är avsett att drivas med tramp- eller vevanordning och inte är ett lekfordon.
G5_sources.supports: An ordinary pedal bicycle is a vehicle even though not motor-driven; a rider is operating a vehicle.
G5_sources.scope_limits: Ordinary pedal bicycle, excluding toy vehicles. No unnecessary e-bike/e-scooter taxonomy or implication that every crossing rule is identical for all vehicles.
